title: Schwelle_Auf-und-Abbau
slide_intent: Give a recurring motif a fixed movement sequence so viewers can recognize it in time as well as shape.
strategic_value: The progressive red bars can make the Schwelle carry DB’s stated association with progress and movement.
demonstration: Red bars build across a dark field, resolve into a thin-to-thick progression, and retract.
practical_value: Use the Schwelle’s defined build and removal sequence rather than inventing a separate animation for each placement.

content_islands.spec: Resolve thin bars at the left and thicker bars at the right before retracting.
